tagline: 本地优先的 AI 小说创作工作台
brief: DreamStory helps authors plan stories, manage world-building, write chapters, and maintain long-term continuity in a calm local-first workspace.

concepts.name: Book & Quote
concepts.idea: A hardcover silhouette, page field, and custom quotation mark make the connection to books and novel writing immediate.
rationale: The book is the first-read shape, so the product category does not depend on an abstract explanation.
The quotation mark turns a generic book into a novel-writing identity.
The compact page field and clear spine provide a stable app-icon and favicon silhouette.

recommendation: Use the horizontal color lockup as the primary signature, the symbol alone for the app/PWA, and the reversed/dark versions on the existing ink UI.
